Local backup

Backup & restore

Export workspace backup

Download an encrypted file with your classes, rosters, attendance, Class Work submission statuses, assessments, scores, authored questions, lessons, and materials. Keep the passphrase separately.

Restore a backup

Choose an encrypted MATEVOK backup or an older JSON backup. Restoring replaces current local classroom records after review and confirmation.

Encrypted backups require the passphrase used at export. MATEVOK cannot recover a lost passphrase. Older unencrypted backups can still be restored and will be clearly identified.

Encrypted local backup

Protect this backup

Use a passphrase of at least 12 characters. MATEVOK does not store it. Save it separately; a lost passphrase cannot be recovered.

Encrypted local backup

Unlock backup

The passphrase is used only to decrypt this file in this browser. It is not sent or saved.

Class Work

Add class work

Class Work records submission status. Gradebook records scores; neither status is inferred from the other.

Delete class work

This permanently deletes the work item and its submission statuses. Student records and Gradebook scores are not changed.

Leave unsaved submission statuses?

These status changes have not been saved on this device.

Leave unsaved attendance?

Changes for this date have not been saved on this device.

Leave unsaved scores?

Score changes have not been saved on this device.

Paste scores

Paste one value per line in the current active-roster order. Blank lines never erase an existing score. Review before applying; Save Scores is still required.

This creates an independent Draft. Students, scores, attendance, reports, progress, and Classroom Mode data are never copied.

Smart gradebook

Create assessment

Scores allow up to three decimal places. Changing a maximum score retains raw scores and recalculates the displayed raw percentage; any score above the new maximum is flagged for correction.

This workspace shows generic raw-score percentages only. It does not apply a DepEd grading policy.

My Materials

Save a reusable template

This saves a separate template on this device. It does not change the class item. Include My Materials in your regular backups.

My Materials

Add to a class

A fresh class-owned Draft will be created. Existing class records and scores are not changed.

Delete library template

Class copies already made from this template are independent and will not be changed.

Reusable student roster

Copy an active roster

Only active student names are copied into this empty class as new independent records. Archived classes can be read-only sources. Attendance, scores, archived students, and history are not copied.

MATEVOK is already open

Workspace in use

Another MATEVOK window currently has editing access. If it is open, finish there or close it and try again. If it is suspended, you can take over after confirming that the other window will become read-only.

Local editing access

Take over this workspace?

The other MATEVOK window will become read-only. Any unsaved edits in that window cannot be saved. Its saved records will remain unchanged.
